name: AOS Community Edition
tagline: An open agent operating system for building and running AI agents
description: AOS Community Edition is an open agent operating system written in Rust and dual-licensed MIT/Apache-2.0. It provides an aos CLI, an HTTP API, and a capsule model for packaging agent capabilities, with provider/model experience and an Unicity Audit layer. The Forge tooling lets an agent inspect the running system, identify a gap, and build a capsule to fill it. It exposes MCP serving for Codex, Claude, and Grok and publishes Sigstore-signed releases.
highlights: Capsule model for packaging and running agent capabilities
Forge constructs OS tooling by inspecting the live system and building missing capsules
MCP serve for Codex, Claude, and Grok interoperability
HTTP API plus aos CLI for programmatic control
curatorNote: A genuinely fresh take on treating the agent as an operating system — Forge's self-inspection loop is the standout idea and 8.6k stars in a month back it up.
